name: nRF54L15 DK (PCA10156)
description: Low-power Bluetooth LE / Thread / Zigbee / Matter kit: 128 MHz Cortex-M33 plus RISC-V coprocessor, J-Link OB debugger, 8 MB external flash, and it can emulate the nRF54L10 and nRF54L05.
notes: MCU has 1.5 MB non-volatile (RRAM) and 256 KB RAM; the board adds 8 MB external SPI flash (flashMB = 1.5 + 8).

Four user LEDs and four buttons, power-measurement pins, 2.4 GHz and NFC antennas plus an SWF RF connector. The Arduino Uno R3-compatible header and the USB-C connector are from memory of Nordic's hardware docs and were not confirmed on the fetched pages.
Board size and usable GPIO count are estimates.
